title: Artifact stageflow manifest & TF module scratchpad
content:
Purpose:
This scratchpad captures a pragmatic, incremental stageflow for moving artifacts into air-gapped/private installs plus a lightweight Terraform module interface sketch to wire seeding, verification, and manifest rollout. Aim: provide a reproducible, testable path that SRE/infra can run with minimal ad-hoc scripts during customer bootstraps and upgrades.

Assumptions / constraints:
- Customers may have zero egress (islanded) or allow outbound to a restricted proxy.
- Artifacts include container images, Helm charts, OCI blobs (model shards), and tarball bundles for operator/CRDs.
- Signing keys are customer-managed; we assume a KMS/HSM or an offline PGP key.
- Bandwidth varies; we need both streaming registry sync and sneakernet-friendly manifests.

High-level stageflow (stages):
1) collect: catalog artifacts by semantic id (component:version:variant) -> generate seed-manifest.json
2) assemble: build curated bundle(s) and layered manifests (index, blobs list, checksums)
3) sign: attach signature(s) + signer metadata to manifest (key id, algorithm, timestamp)
4) transport: push to proxy-registry OR export bundle + manifest for physical transport
5) ingest: registry-seed operator or CLI validates signature -> imports blobs into local registry/storage
6) verify: smoke-run deploys minimal canary using imported artifacts
7) promote: mark manifest as active and optionally garbage-collect older manifests

Manifest schema (sketch) - flat keys (example):
- manifest_version: "v1"
- manifest_id: "rwd-artifact-20250112-23"
- created_by: "ci-seed/jenkins"
- created_at: "2025-01-12T21:03:00Z"
- artifacts: ["componentA:1.2.0:amd64","console:3.0.1:arm64","models/gpt-2:shard-0:quant" ]
- artifact_index_url: "file://./blobs/index.json" OR "oci://registry.internal.example/repo/index:manifest-id"
- signature: "sha256:..."
- signer_key: "pgp:0xABCD1234"
- transport_hints: ["sneakernet","registry-proxy","rsync-over-ssh"]
- checksum_manifest: "sha256:..."

File layout in bundle (for sneakernet):
- /manifest.json (top-level metadata + signature)
- /index.json (artifact list + blob refs)
- /blobs/*.tar.gz or blobs/<digest>.bin
- /checksums.sha256
- /signature.asc
- /tf-hooks/ (optional terraform state hooks and import scripts)

Verification checklist (automated + manual):
- verify signature against trusted keyring
- verify checksums of each blob
- ensure all referenced artifacts present in index.json
- run 'registry-seed --dry-run' to validate import plan
- deploy canary helm release using local registry references and run smoke tests (health, token exchange, KV-cache warmup)
- confirm image provenance metadata (labels, build id) matches manifest

Terraform module sketch (api-oriented notes) - responsibilities: fetch manifest metadata, stage artifacts to a target registry endpoint, trigger a registry-seed operator job, optionally mark a TF-managed resource as 'manifest_applied'.
Inputs (variables):
- var manifest_source (string) -> url|gs://|file:// path to manifest bundle
- var target_registry (string) -> registry endpoint inside customer VPC
- var trust_key_id (string) -> id for signature verification
- var transport_mode (string) -> ["registry-proxy","sneakernet","rsync"]
- var seed_timeout (string) -> timeouts for operator job
- var allow_overwrite (bool as string) -> "true"|"false"
Outputs (state-tracked):
- output manifest_applied (string) -> manifest_id
- output registry_seed_job (string) -> job id for monitoring

Sample HCL usage (concept, not full module):
module "artifact_seed" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-infra/terraform-modules.git//artifact-seed?ref=experimental"
  manifest_source = "file:///mnt/usb/rwd-seed-20250112.tar.gz"
  target_registry = "registry.internal.corp:5000"
  trust_key_id = "pgp:0xABCD1234"
  transport_mode = "sneakernet"
}

Notes on implementation details / edge cases:
- Partial import: manifest may reference large model shards; allow progressive import with a chunked index and 'imported_blobs' state so deploys can start earlier.
- Rollback: keep previous active-manifest id; registry-seed should be able to garbage-collect only after "promote" window.
- Atomicity: use manifest lifecycle tags (staged -> imported -> verified -> active). Avoid overriding active-tag until verification passes.
- Authorization: seeding process should authenticate to registry via mutual TLS cert or short-lived token created by TF hooks.

Upgrade plan (customer air-gapped upgrade v1.9 -> v2.0) - minimal steps:
1) prepare upstream bundle: build v2.0 artifacts, generate manifest v2, produce checksums and signatures
2) dry-run locally: run import CLI with --validate-only against a staging registry (non-prod)
3) deliver bundle to customer (sneakernet or proxy sync)
4) run 'registry-seed --import manifest.json' (record job id)
5) once import completes, trigger canary deploy of control-plane components (console + router) using manifest:tagged images
6) run smoke tests (api ping, model inference smoke, auth flows)
7) if tests pass, promote manifest to active and schedule GC of old blobs after X days
8) if tests fail, mark manifest as failed, keep previous manifest active and open revert ticket (JIRA)

Open questions / TODOs:
- Decide canonical manifest versioning format (timestamps vs semver + build-id).
- Define TTL for staged manifests before automatic garbage collection.
- Integrate with Redwood Console to show import progress and manifest metadata.
- Provide a small 'verify-bundle' container image for customers that runs all prechecks offline.
- Create unit/integration tests for TF module that mock a local registry (harbor/registry:2)

Quick commands (notes for operator):
- generate manifest: rwd-manifest build --input-list artifacts.txt --out manifest.tar.gz --sign --key /keys/seed.pgp
- validate bundle: rwd-manifest verify manifest.tar.gz --keyring /keys/trusted.gpg
- import: registry-seed import --manifest ./manifest.json --registry registry.internal:5000 --auth /secrets/registry-creds.json
- dry-run: registry-seed import --manifest ./manifest.json --dry-run

Appendix (references):
- related docs: CONFLUENCE:PD-ARTIFACT-SEED (seed design notes)
- existing PR: GH:repo-infra/PR-5421 (registry proxy support)
- customer ticket template: JIRA:DEPLOY-88

Status: draft — this is a working playbook. Comments welcome on the manifest schema and TF interface.
